findings.detail: The Alltech row prints fair value 3,001 and 0.4% of net assets, but schedule net assets of 859,855 imply 3,439.42 for a 0.4% row or about 0.3% for fair value 3,001.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation used the filing's own schedule totals: total investments are 1,488,856 and total net assets are 859,855, with total investments reported as 173.1% of net assets. The localized Alltech source row is aligned to the Schedule of Investments columns and prints fair value 3,001 with % of net assets 0.4. Using the filing net-assets anchor, 0.4% corresponds to 3,439.42, while fair value 3,001 is about 0.349% and rounds to 0.3 at one decimal. The raw source therefore confirms a real pct_of_net_assets identity defect rather than an extraction false alarm.
